prompt: In exactly two short sentences, explain why the Moon has phases. Start with the words The Moon. Return only plain text.
response: The Moon has phases because sunlight always lights one half of it, and from Earth we see a changing fraction of that lit half as the Moon orbits us. The phase we see depends on the angle between the Sun, Earth, and Moon, which cycles roughly every 29.5 days.
